findings.summary: For self-employed users, years 1-5 show only empty boxes and a note, while a figure from another product (25,725) sits in the same spot. That makes the main result easy to misread.
The red/pink 'לפני 6 שנים: מס' line above the chart is alarming because it doesn't say how much tax applies. The reader doesn't mention the chart jumping.
Small grey hint text on a dark background is hard to read.
The terms 'מסלול מדד' and S&P are used without explanation.
The 7% default return has no note about risk.
